title: Lobsters March in Single File for Up to 50 Kilometers

scenes.text: Lobsters march in a line across the ocean floor.
It is the Caribbean spiny lobster, and it walks in single file.
Up to 65 of them line up, one behind the other.
They walk for as far as 30 to 50 kilometers.
They go in late autumn, after the first big storms.
An underwater parade, led by the first lobster.

description:
Caribbean spiny lobsters march in single file lines of up to 65 animals, one behind the other.
